note: Zaburi 119:16 ('I will not forget thy word', the Memorial's last line) is not quoted anywhere in the shipped sw corpus, so it is self-rendered in the Swahili Union Version idiom ('Sitalisahau neno lako'); a reviewer should check it against the SUV.
2 Timotheo 1:12 (the seal motto Scio cui credidi) is pasted verbatim from thoughts-for-the-quiet-hour.sw.json (also in gleanings-among-the-sheaves.sw.json).

'Mungu wa Ibrahimu, Mungu wa Isaka, Mungu wa Yakobo' is Pascal's own Memorial wording echoing Exodus 3:6, rendered as his prose (it matches the SUV words in the-god-of-all-comfort.sw.json); the Gethsemane sayings from 'The Mystery of Jesus' are Pascal's words, not scripture.

Clock times are CONVERTED to Swahili reckoning (10:30 pm = saa nne na nusu usiku; 12:30 am = saa sita na nusu usiku wa manane; 1 am = saa saba usiku). The reviewer may prefer the keep-the-number convention.
